# Approved visual brief

Create a complete interactive reading website with an included presentation. Use editorial hierarchy, generous section compositions, prominent accurate figures, curved process connectors where useful, and varied slide compositions. Avoid a wall of identical cards or a plain text deck. Use the supplied original brand mark without distorting its contours; a faithful light/dark ink variant is allowed. The reading page alternates light and dark in visible section order. Keep a clear agenda and exact Presentation Mode entries in the hero and global navigation, both starting slide 1. Rich gradients, curves and restrained shadows are valid where they improve the explanation.

Use mixed slide themes and deep-dive presentation depth, comprehensive reading coverage and balanced interaction. Include all source facts and uncertainty without adding slides beyond the frozen budget. Preserve complete diagrams and make chart inspection meaningful. Additional imagery: none; no stock, AI imagery or network research is authorized. Retain sources, original inputs, model, assets and deterministic rebuild/check commands. Desktop slides fit without stage scrolling; compact screens reflow. No questions are needed: these choices are approved for this neutral qualification run.
